scripts.build: cross-env JOIASK_INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME= JOIASK_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD= NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build && npm run build:docs && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: npm run copy:asset -- admin/out dist/client/admin && npm run copy:asset -- docs/out dist/client/docs && npm run build:monaco
scripts.build:monaco: npm run copy:asset -- admin/node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs dist/client/admin/monaco/vs && npm run copy:asset -- admin/node_modules/monaco-editor/LICENSE dist/client/admin/monaco/LICENSE && npm run copy:asset -- admin/node_modules/monaco-editor/ThirdPartyNotices.txt dist/client/admin/monaco/ThirdPartyNotices.txt
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit && npm --prefix admin ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit && npm --prefix docs ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit
scripts.test: npm run test:content-markup && npm run test:worker
